name: Artoghrul Rashid
tagline: Full-stack engineer, ex-robotics mentor, occasional bassist. Based in Baku.
intro: I'm a full-stack web developer in Baku. Right now I build internal systems and landing pages at Megasec, freelance on CRMs, Shopify apps, and automation on the side, and study Computer Science at ADA. Before the web pulled me in, I spent two years teaching robotics, programming, and electronics to kids and coaching competition teams – still the best way I know to actually learn something: explain it to a twelve-year-old until it works. I write across the stack – React/Next and Astro up front, Laravel/Node with Mongo and MySQL behind – and there's usually an ESP32 and a soldering iron somewhere on the desk.

experience.description: Building internal management systems and backend services in Laravel/PHP – workflow automation and database-driven features – plus responsive landing pages in Next.js, with a focus on performance and UX.
Web apps, CRM systems, and automation platforms in Node.js, Laravel, and Google Apps Script. Shopify integrations and frontends in Next.js, React, and Astro.

Taught kids aged 3–16 through project-based learning with VEX, LEGO SPIKE Prime, Arduino, and ESP32. Coached robotics competition teams, prepared students for international competitions, and trained staff.
